title: Task requests
description: Post and manage buyer requests for quotes, custom work, or procurement.

help.title: About Task requests
help.overview: A task request is a buyer's brief asking providers for quotes: what they need, in which category and place, and for what budget. It is open for bids for 30 days. Accepting a bid awards it and opens an order.

sections.title: Fields
items: Title, category, budget minimum and maximum, currency, address, and main image are required; description and galleries are optional.
The requester is whoever posts it. Category and city decide which providers are told about it.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Open: taking bids until it expires.
Closed: no longer taking bids, by the requester's choice or because 30 days passed. An hourly job closes expired requests.
Awarded: a bid was accepted; the status can no longer change.

sections.title: Actions
sections.body: Only the requester, or an administrator, can change status.
items: Close: from open. Everyone with a pending bid is notified.
Reopen: from closed. It restarts the 30-day window, so an expired request is not closed again straight away.
Notify all: tells every provider with an active listing in the same category and city about the request, again.

sections.title: Bids and awarding
items: Providers bid while it is open and unexpired; nobody can bid on their own request.
Accepting a bid rejects the others, marks the request awarded, and opens a pending order between requester and bidder.
Each row shows how many live bids it has. Non-administrators see their own requests.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
